title: Author simple Go unit tests for ProjHub MCP security and product-regression behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: ping_team_server must treat target as plain data. In one test, call it with at least two shell-style payloads such as semicolon, pipe, ampersand/&&, or backtick inputs, and assert the serialized tool responses contain no execution artifacts such as uid=, gid=, whoami, or command output. In the same test, call any benign target such as 127.0.0.1, example.com, or build.example.com and assert a normal output field or ok-style output is present.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents shell-style input from becoming command execution while preserving benign ping behavior.

ground_truth_issues.description: Internal comments must stay hidden from non-admin users while public comments remain visible. Call list_task_comments on task-alpha as user-key, serialize the returned value or error response to JSON, assert the alpha public comment text appears, and assert SENTINEL_INTERNAL_COMMENT_ALPHA is absent. Also verify that a user-key attempt involving task-beta does not reveal SENTINEL_INTERNAL_COMMENT_BETA, either by returning Forbidden/error or by returning serialized content without that marker.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Protects internal comment content while preserving ordinary same-team comment visibility.

ground_truth_issues.description: Non-admin project reads must not expose privileged project markers, while admin reads still can. Call get_project for project-alpha as user-key and assert the serialized response does not contain SENTINEL_ADMIN_CONFIG_ALPHA or SENTINEL_INTERNAL_METRICS_ALPHA. Then call get_project for the same project as admin-key and assert at least one of those privileged markers is present.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures privileged project metadata is redacted for ordinary users but remains available to admins.

ground_truth_issues.description: In a single test, call calculate_budget with one dangerous expression and one arithmetic expression, and assert no execution artifacts appear and the arithmetic result is correct.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents unsafe expression execution while ensuring correct arithmetic behavior.

ground_truth_issues.description: load_custom_formatter must reject dangerous names while preserving safe formatter loading. In one test, call it with at least one path-style name such as ../secrets, ../../etc/passwd, /tmp/x.py, or /etc/shadow and at least one dangerous module-style name such as os or subprocess; assert the dangerous serialized responses do not report a Loaded status. Then call it with json and assert Loaded json appears.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents unsafe formatter/module loading while preserving safe built-in formatter loading.

ground_truth_issues.description: A user-key caller must not read beta project data and must still read alpha project data. Call get_project for project-beta as user-key and assert the serialized response is an error/Forbidden or otherwise does not contain SENTINEL_ADMIN_CONFIG_BETA. Then call get_project for project-alpha as user-key and assert project-alpha or Apollo appears.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Enforces project team boundaries while preserving same-team project access.

ground_truth_issues.description: Create a task under project-alpha, update it using the returned task_id, and assert the updated title is reflected.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures valid same-team task updates are not blocked.

ground_truth_issues.description: Create a task with a unique title and verify search_tasks returns it for the same user.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures same-team task search works as expected.

ground_truth_issues.description: Create a task, delete it using its task_id, and assert the returned deleted ID matches.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures task deletion behavior is correct.

ground_truth_issues.description: Create a task, capture task_id, update that same task_id, and assert the updated value appears.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Validates a simple task update workflow.

ground_truth_issues.description: Admin project setup must remain usable in one flow. As admin-key, create a team that includes alice-uuid, capture the returned team ID, create a project under that same team ID, capture project_id, then call get_project for that same project_id and assert the serialized response contains the captured project ID and created project name.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures administrative team and project setup remains functional after hardening.

ground_truth_issues.description: fetch_project_asset must not return internal metadata for internal-looking URLs and must still handle a benign public-looking URL. Call it with at least one internal-address URL such as localhost, 127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, 0.0.0.0, or [::1] and assert SENTINEL_INTERNAL_METADATA_PAYLOAD is absent. Then call it with a benign public-looking URL and assert a content field or public asset preview is returned.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents internal asset-fetch exposure while preserving benign public asset retrieval.

ground_truth_issues.description: Non-admin or no-token diagnostic calls must not reveal obvious privileged secrets. Call admin_sysinfo and legacy_dump through the normal tool path as user-key or without token parameters and assert serialized responses do not contain SENTINEL_SYSINFO_SECRET or super_secret_legacy_key_123!.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents diagnostic and legacy tools from leaking privileged secrets.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests isolate state by using seeded IDs intentionally or by creating fresh resources with unique markers. Tests must not depend on ordering or state mutated by another test.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures the submitted test suite is repeatable and order-independent.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests use serialized full-response assertions, captured IDs, sentinel markers, and small reusable helpers. Exception-only, status-only, broad truthiness-only, or single-tool-without-setup tests do not satisfy this criterion.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Encourages robust tests with explicit content, state, and identity assertions.
